name: The Temple of St. Rylan is built
description: About 400 years ago, in the style of the IIIrd Emperor.

name: Archmage Hann takes two spheres
description: 33 years ago. He leaves a note promising their return and seals the Thing in the tavern cellar. The Empire's decline starts about now.

name: Marcos researches the spheres
description: Over years, Marcos finds the clues proving the spheres exist, and works out the paths to the temple. He writes the letter and annotates the map.

name: The death of Marcos
description: Too old, as he says himself, to walk the paths he found.

name: The reading of Marcos's will
description: Each PC receives the same letter and annotated map.

name: The Autumn Equinox
description: The temple doors open at dawn (6am) and close 24 hours later. Two days after the party sets out from the fork.
